如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    只不过片刻时间，鼻烟壶底下的“乾隆”字样就开始“融化”开来了。就像是墨碰到了水一样，彻底糊化了。
杨云帆不留痕迹的做完一切，而后，则是“哈哈”大笑一声，将鼻烟壶底下的字迹给周围群众挨个看了一遍，道：“诸位都是混迹这一行的专家老手了。大家说，这个东西，值不值五百万？”
其他人一看那鼻烟壶的底下，那字迹简直一塌糊涂，就连最低级的仿冒品都比这做得好。
“我呸！这东西，依我看，连五百块都不值！这么劣等的仿冒品，居然还大言不惭的说要五百万！林老板，你的心肠未免太黑了！你这家玉祖轩，反正我以后是再也不敢进去买东西了。”
一个老者模样的人，看来是附近开古玩店的同行，这时候也是摇头叹息道：“林老板，往日你的为人我就颇为不齿，只是我看你做事还留三分余地，才一直没有多说。可今天这东西，你拿出来要价五百万，这是把我们湘潭古玩界的老脸都丢光了。你这玉祖轩的店面，是许老爷子留下的，我明天就给他打电话，你搬出去吧。”
其他人也都纷纷鄙视这林老板。说他简直丢人现眼。
连跟他一同来的老者，看了这底下的字迹后，也是一脸鄙夷，冷哼了一声道：“林老板，原来你是这种人！幸好今天，我在这里遇到了这个小哥。不然，怕是要被你骗光了钱。我们的交易，就此作罢了！”
那中年人却不知道他们到底看到了什么，这东西虽然是赝品，可是做工绝对可以以假乱真。他找了好几个专家都看不出一丝作假的痕迹。难道，那几个专家没看出来，今日这里几个凡夫俗子眼界向来奇差的“打眼们”却是都看出真假来了？
这不可能！
“拿过来，拿过来，让我看！”那中年人一把抢过杨云帆手里的鼻烟壶。
随后，当他看到鼻烟壶底下的“乾隆”字迹，居然开始化开了。就跟刚写的字，遇到了水一样。
他的面色一下子惨白无比！继而，怒火攻心。在他看来，这一切的原因，只能是眼前这个臭小子干的！
“啊！我跟你拼了！”
那中年男子咆哮着，猛然朝着杨云帆扑了过来。他已经被杨云帆刺激的头脑充血，失去理智了。显然是忘记了，刚才老者跟杨云帆说话间，可是提到过对方可是一身本事的。
眼看那中年男子毫无章法的扑过来，杨云帆根本没把他当成一回事。他的身法灵动无比，只是几步，脚下就倒转乾坤，在对方扑来的瞬间，极快的朝着左边一个挪移。
那中年人就摔了一个狗吃屎。
周围顿时轰然大笑。
“就这么几下子，也敢找我麻烦，真是白痴。”
杨云帆摇摇脑袋，提着自己那一袋子黄符正准备离开。
不过这时，刚才那个老者却拉了杨云帆一下，道：“小伙子，我看你对玉石好像很有了解。那边有家玉器店，这几天一直在玩赌石。要不，你陪老夫去玩一把。”

见杨云帆有些为难，那老者跟人精一样，顿时明白了一切，笑道：“你放心，购买原石的所有费用都有老夫来出。要是切到了好东西，我们平分！”
还有这种好事？
杨云帆不由看了那老头一眼，道：“老人家如何称呼？”
那老头笑道：“老何姓叶。老夫托个大，你就叫我叶老伯吧。老夫我这次来湘潭市，就是为了找一些好的玉石。我有大用。”
“好。我同意了。叶老伯，你带路吧。”那老头说的神秘，杨云帆也懒得多管，难得遇到不要本钱的买卖，不干是傻子！
静轩玉器，乃是湘潭市最大的玉器店。
每年夏天，他们都会从缅甸挖来不少原石，进行几次公开赌石。一来给玉器店打响名头，二来也可以赚取一笔不菲的费用。
这种赌石节目进行了几年，到了现在，业内对翡翠玉石情有独钟的人都来到了这里。
杨云帆和叶老伯来到这里的时候，此处早就已经是人潮涌动，几乎把门槛都给踏破。
“老叶，我还以为你不会来了呢。”就在杨云帆两个人刚刚走进玉器店的时候，忽然，一道惊喜的声音在他们不远处响起，而后，一个白胡子老头笑吟吟的朝他们两个人走了过来。
“哈哈，老陈，你来的比我早啊。”看着白胡子老头，叶老伯也是连忙叫道。
“嗯？这位是……”这时，那白胡子老头注意到了叶老伯身边的杨云帆。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. In just a moment, the words "Qianlong" under the snuff bottle began to "melt". It was like ink hitting water, completely gelatinized.
Yang Yunfan finished everything without leaving any trace, and then he laughed "haha", read the writing under the snuff bottle to the surrounding people one by one, and said: "You are all experts and veterans in this industry. Everyone, tell me, is this thing worth five million?"
When others looked at the bottom of the snuff bottle, they saw that the writing was a mess, and even the lowest counterfeit was better than this.
"Bah! This thing, in my opinion, isn't even worth five hundred yuan! Such a low-grade counterfeit product, and you even boast that it costs five million yuan! Boss Lin, you are too dark-hearted! Anyway, I will never dare to go in and buy anything from your Yuzuxuan store again."
A man who looked like an old man, who seemed to be a colleague who opened an antique store nearby, also shook his head and sighed: "Boss Lin, I used to be quite disdainful of your behavior in the past. It's just that I think you still have three points of leeway in doing things, so I haven't done much." "But if you ask for five million for this thing today, you will lose all our faces in the Xiangtan antique industry. Your Yuzuxuan store is owned by Mr. Xu. I will call him tomorrow and ask you to move out."
Everyone else also despised Boss Lin. Said he was simply a disgrace.
Even the old man who came with him had a look of disdain after reading the handwriting underneath. He snorted coldly and said, "Boss Lin, it turns out you are this kind of person! Fortunately, I met this little brother here today. Otherwise, I'm afraid you would have defrauded me of all my money. Our deal is over!"
The middle-aged people didn't know what they saw. Although this thing was a fake, the workmanship could definitely be fake. He consulted several experts but could not find any trace of fraud. Could it be that those experts didn't see that today, the ordinary people here, who have always had a very poor vision, can tell the truth from the false?
This is impossible!
"Bring it here, bring it here, let me see it!" The middle-aged man snatched the snuff bottle from Yang Yunfan's hand.
Later, when he saw the writing "Qianlong" under the snuff bottle, it actually began to melt away. It's like the words you just wrote encountered water.
His complexion suddenly turned extremely pale! Then, anger seized his heart. In his opinion, the cause of all this can only be the work of this brat in front of him!
"Ah! I'll fight you!"
The middle-aged man roared and suddenly rushed towards Yang Yunfan. His brain was so stimulated by Yang Yunfan that he lost his mind. Apparently he had forgotten that when the old man was talking to Yang Yunfan just now, he mentioned that the other party was very capable.
Seeing the middle-aged man rushing towards him without any plan, Yang Yunfan didn't take him seriously at all. His movements were extremely agile. In just a few steps, the world was turned upside down under his feet. The moment the opponent rushed towards him, he moved very quickly to the left.
The middle-aged man threw a dog and ate its shit.
The surrounding people burst into laughter.
"You dare to cause trouble for me just this few times. What an idiot."
Yang Yunfan shook his head and was about to leave with his bag of yellow talismans.
But at this time, the old man just pulled Yang Yunfan and said: "Young man, I think you seem to know a lot about jade. There is a jade shop over there, and they have been gambling on stones these days. How about you accompany me to play."
Seeing that Yang Yunfan was in a bit of a dilemma, the old man, like a human spirit, understood everything immediately and said with a smile: "Don't worry, I will pay for all the expenses for purchasing the rough stones. If we find something good, we will split it equally!"
Is there such a good thing?
Yang Yunfan couldn't help but glance at the old man and said, "What do you call him?"
The old man smiled and said: "Old He's surname is Ye. ISorry, just call me Uncle Ye. I came to Xiangtan City this time just to find some good jade. I'm of great use. "
"good. I agreed. Uncle Ye, please lead the way. "The old man said something mysterious, and Yang Yunfan didn't bother to take care of it. It's rare to encounter a business that doesn't require capital. If you don't do it, you'd be a fool!
Jingxuan Jade is the largest jade shop in Xiangtan City.
Every summer, they dig out a lot of rough stones from Myanmar and conduct public stone betting several times. Firstly, it gives the jade shop a good name, and secondly, it can also earn a lot of money.
This stone gambling program has been going on for several years, and now, people in the industry who have a soft spot for jadeite have come here.
When Yang Yunfan and Uncle Ye came here, the place was already crowded with people, almost crossing the threshold.
"Lao Ye, I thought you wouldn't come. "Just when Yang Yunfan and two people just walked into the jade shop, suddenly, a voice of surprise sounded not far from them, and then, an old man with a white beard walked towards the two of them with a smile.
"Haha, Lao Chen, you came earlier than me. "Looking at the old man with a white beard, Mr. Ye also shouted quickly.
"Huh? This is..." At this time, the old man with the white beard noticed Yang Yunfan next to Uncle Ye.
